warnings.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for North West Slopes and Plains
warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Tamworth, Gunnedah, Barraba, Mullaley, Boggabri and Bingara. 94 km/h wind gust was recorded at Narrabri at 7:50 pm.

warnings.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for North West Pastoral, North East Pastoral
warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds and large hailstones in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Dalhousie Springs.

warnings.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Barkly, Simpson
warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds and large hailstones in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Jervois, Finke and Simpson District east of Finke. Severe thunderstorms are no longer occurring in the Lasseter district and the warning for this district is CANCELLED. 96km/h wind gust was recorded at Alice Springs at 3:44pm.
